capabilities: Extract propositions, typed logical edges, actions, and problems from pasted text or .md/.txt/.pdf/.mp3 files
Detect contradictions and resolve them by reclassifying edges, adding parent premises, or discarding claims
Answer questions in a folder-grounded chat workbench with verified [[node]] citations
Generate folder analysis reports and visualize, export, or delete graphs
Gate every AI operation behind an estimated token, cost, and time confirmation dialog
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat assistant; its chat is a workbench that must answer from the folder's proposition graph and cite existing nodes.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. UI and AI output are bilingual (Korean/English). Cost figures in the preflight gate are estimates; Claude CLI costs are shown as API-equivalent references.
problem: Obsidian links are untyped and contradictions between notes go unnoticed; there is no built-in way to decompose text into verifiable claims or query notes with source-traceable answers.
